inputs.xtext_rule_text:
FeatureChainMember returns SysML::Membership :
	  memberElement = [SysML::Feature | QualifiedName]
	| {SysML::OwningMembership} ownedRelatedElement += OwnedFeatureChain 
;

decision: A feature reference member or an owned feature chain member, as KerML 8.2.5.8.2 states it.
notes:
THIS IS THE KERML VARIANT (ADR-0014). The other language states this production differently and is a separate unit, derived from its own clause and not consulted here. KerML reaches the single-name alternative through a named FeatureReferenceMember production.

The two languages' bodies differ in factoring and, as far as their expansions go, accept the same text. That is recorded, not relied on: equivalence across languages is not something this unit asserts, which is why the production was split at all.

The Xtext (KerMLExpressions.xtext, shared by both languages) inlines the first alternative as a qualified-name cross-reference. That inlining is not ported; KerML's clause names the production.

evidence.note: same two alternatives, the first inlined as a QualifiedName cross-reference
